system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:50:49 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 sent 51,000,389 bytes to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080; the connection record shows 8,922 bytes in the reverse direction.
The available record for the 51 MB transfer identifies the proxy as the network peer but does not identify the destination service, request, or initiating process.

The detailed proxy records shown later identify Chrome traffic to Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft sign-in services, but they are from 14:10 and do not establish the destination or purpose of the 13:50 transfer.
DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM from 13:20:31 to 13:21:41; these records do not link it to the large transfer roughly 29 minutes later.
WS-ICHEN-01 made SMB connections to DC-NWD-01 at 13:43 and 14:14, with corresponding network logons for the workstation computer account; the records do not show which shares or files were accessed.
The large outbound volume to an unidentified destination is a security concern, but the available records do not establish that it was an unauthorized upload or exfiltration.

known_telemetry_limitations: The transfer record provides byte counts and the proxy's internal IP, but no destination hostname, URL, method, tunnel details, or content. (T059-00174)

No supplied endpoint process-connection record attributes the 13:50 proxy connection to a specific application; the Chrome process records are for later connections. (T059-00174, T059-00281, T059-00300)
The SMB records show connections and logons but not the share, file operations, or data transferred. (T059-00092, T059-00095, T059-00350, T059-00354)
claims_not_established: The external service or recipient involved in the 51 MB transfer.
Whether the transfer was an upload of files, what data it contained, or whether it was authorized.
Which process initiated the transfer and which user action, if any, caused it.
Whether the SMB connections accessed sensitive data or were related to the outbound transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy request and tunnel logs for the 13:50:49 connection, including destination hostname, URL, method, authenticated user, byte accounting, and any associated tunnel/session identifiers.
Endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:50 UTC, including process creation, socket ownership, browser or sync-client activity, and file access events.
File inventory and audit evidence identifying files read or staged immediately before the transfer.
Available OneDrive, browser, and other approved-service audit logs to determine whether the transfer matches authorized activity.
Share-level and file-operation logs for the SMB connections to DC-NWD-01.
